column1: # header lint (14z-122). One row per allowed header:  path <TAB> header-regex
# <TAB> reason. EVERY row must match at least one header in its file — a row
# matching nothing FAILS as a dead allowance, so the list cannot outlive its
# reasons. Expected to stay nearly empty; a session-shaped header in a
# REFERENCE document is normally the thing the pass removes, not allows.

column3: A deliberate tombstone: the note is kept as written with its SUPERSEDED marker, which the lint must keep visible by design
